auth.description:
Connect Activepieces to your Outseta account using the Admin API.

**To get your credentials:**
1. Log in to your Outseta account
2. Go to **Settings → Integrations → API**
3. Copy your **API Key** and **API Secret**
4. Your domain is your Outseta subdomain, e.g. `https://yourcompany.outseta.com`

Need help? See [Outseta API docs](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/3613332/outseta-rest-api-v1).

domain.description: Your full Outseta domain URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.outseta.com

apiKey.description: Found in Outseta → Settings → Integrations → API

apiSecret.description: Found alongside your API Key in Outseta → Settings → Integrations → API

get_account.name: get_account
get_account.description: Retrieve an account by its UID, or by the email of its primary contact. Returns plan, subscription, billing address, primary contact and add-on details.

lookupBy.description: How to find the account to retrieve.

accountUid.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Account UID.

primaryContactEmail.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Primary contact email. The action will resolve the email to the linked account.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Outseta CRM account by its UID or by its primary contact email, returning core fields plus billing address, primary contact, and current subscription/plan/add-on details. Use to read an account by either identifier. Read-only and idempotent.

get_person.name: get_person
get_person.description: Retrieve a person by email or by UID, including the linked account.

lookupBy.description: How to find the person to retrieve.

email.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Email.

personUid.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Person UID.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Outseta CRM person (contact) by email or by UID, returning identity, contact, and mailing-address fields plus the linked account. Use to read a person by either identifier. Read-only and idempotent.

get_deal.name: get_deal
get_deal.description: Retrieve a deal by its UID, or by the email of the contact associated with the deal plus the pipeline.

lookupBy.description: How to find the deal to retrieve.

dealUid.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Deal UID.

contactEmail.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Contact email + pipeline.

get_subscription.name: get_subscription
get_subscription.description: Retrieve a subscription by its UID, or fetch the current subscription of an account by Account UID. Returns plan, billing terms, renewal dates, discount, and add-on details.

lookupBy.description: How to find the subscription to retrieve.

subscriptionUid.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Subscription UID.

accountUid.description: Used when "Lookup by" is set to Account UID. Resolves to the account's current subscription.

get_last_payment.name: get_last_payment
get_last_payment.description: Retrieve the most recent payment transaction for an account. Returns found=false if no payment has ever been recorded.

accountUid.description: The UID of the account to retrieve the last payment for.

aiMetadata.description: Returns the single most recent payment transaction for an account, or found=false if none exists. Use for the latest payment only; for the full payment/refund/invoice history use List Account Transactions. Read-only and idempotent.

create_account.name: create_account
create_account.description: Create a new account in Outseta CRM. Optionally start a subscription on a plan in the same call.

clientIdentifier.description: A custom identifier you assign to this account (e.g. your internal customer ID).

invoiceNotes.description: Notes that appear on invoices sent to this account.

primaryContactPersonUid.description: Optional. UID of an existing person to set as primary contact on the new account. Required by Outseta when starting a subscription with a paid plan.

aiMetadata.description: Changes the plan on an account's current subscription (upgrade, downgrade, or switch to free) and sets the billing renewal term, identified by account UID. Use to move an account between plans. Requires the account to already have an active subscription, otherwise it errors. Not idempotent: it is a billing mutation that can prorate/charge, so repeating may have further effect.

cancel_subscription.name: cancel_subscription
cancel_subscription.description: Cancel the current subscription on an account. By default, the subscription expires at the end of the current term. You can also cancel immediately.

accountUid.description: The UID of the account whose subscription to cancel.

cancelImmediately.description: If checked, the subscription is cancelled immediately. Otherwise it expires at the end of the current billing term.

aiMetadata.description: Requests cancellation of an account's current subscription, identified by account UID. Defaults to expiring at the end of the current billing term; with cancel-immediately enabled it also forces the account to the Expired stage right away. Use to churn or downgrade an account. Optional cancellation reason and comment can be recorded. Not idempotent: it mutates subscription/account state.

remove_cancellation.name: remove_cancellation
remove_cancellation.description: Remove a pending cancellation request from an account, keeping the subscription active.

accountUid.description: The UID of the account whose cancellation should be removed.

aiMetadata.description: Removes a pending cancellation on an account's subscription, keeping it active, by account UID. Use to reverse a scheduled cancellation; to schedule one use Cancel Subscription. Idempotent: calling it on a subscription that is not cancelling leaves it active.
